description: Selectable policy assets that no default or maintained consumer reaches, each with an owner, the reason it stays and the date by which it is retired or renewed. tests/repository/test_policy_retention.py derives the unreached set and requires exactly these entries; ora/policy/README.md, 'Versions, patches and retirement', states the rule.

robodojo_toolkit_v6.reason: The baseline of the sealed RoboDojo runs on robodojo_placement_toolkit_v5, and of anything that names that surface.

native_atomic_causal_v1.reason: The Synthetic Native test fixtures' surface (tests/support); its base definitions are also local_atomic_cpu_v1's. Moving it under tests/ needs a registration seam: the resolver loads only locked components under ora/policy/tool_surfaces.

robodojo_placement_toolkit_v5.reason: Sealed RoboDojo runs from 2026-10-30 to 2026-11-02 bind this surface and its check_task grants, and resolve_toolkit_surface reads them from here. Named explicitly it still gives a run with the official check.

context_keep_written_unaged_reasoning.reason: Arm H of the context experiment of 2026-11-04 and the default of RoboDojo and of code mode from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05, when context_keep_written (the experiment's best arm with preview optional, 15 of 30) replaced it. Sealed runs name it; it stays an explicit option.
